d: Short, swept-back honey blonde hair accompanies sharp, confident eyes hidden behind dark sunglasses, featuring a youthful face with a mature, focused expression. A lean and athletic build is clad in a form-fitting black tactical bodysuit with blue accents, layered under a long black coat with a vivid blue lining and flowing coattails. The ensemble includes a black utility belt with silver buckles and integrated black armored plating on the legs. Signature details consist of massive, mechanical black and blue energy gauntlets on both arms that glow with cyan light, accompanied by floating black mechanical shards.
